meta.source: Held-out trials of the exported model tcformer-B-s002-mi (not training data)
meta.subject: S002
caveats: Best-case flagship subject chosen on this evaluation data; optimistic.
Time axis is replay time, not recording time; windows are grouped by trial.

signal.traces: full-rate samples of the displayed channels, as the model sees them (common average reference, 4-40 Hz band-pass, z-scored per channel inside each 1 s window)
signal.band_power: relative power: share of the 4-40 Hz power of the window, Hann window, per displayed channel
signal.alignment: checks 1-3 passed (window count, trial ids, true classes); ONNX reproduces the stored predictions on 1.0000 of windows (mean |dp| = 1.3e-07)
